chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:
"The qunūt in the witr prayer is seeking forgiveness, and in the obligatory prayer it is supplication."

key_terms.الْقُنُوتُ: the supplicatory act recited in prayer at the designated point
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: the witr prayer, the odd-unit night prayer

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in qunūt during the witr and obligatory prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith distinguishes the focus of qunūt in different prayers. In the witr prayer, its emphasis is istighfar, while in the obligatory prayers, it is du'a in a general sense.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1411 - It is narrated by Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"The Qunoot (supplication) in the Witr prayer is for seeking forgiveness, while in the obligatory (prayers) it is for supplication (general prayers)”.
